By default ignore whitespace amount changes and trailing whitespace, like diff -b. Set ignore_space_changes=no for exact comparison. Default to normal diff output; use output_format=unified for unified output with three context lines.

commands.name: display_version_diff
commands.summary: Compare source for all changed decks in two library versions.

arguments.name: from_version
arguments.description: Library version to compare from. Defaults to the locked version before the current version.

arguments.name: to_version
arguments.description: Library version to compare to. Defaults to the current library version, including automatically saved interactive edits.

arguments.name: ignore_space_changes
arguments.description: Ignore trailing whitespace and changes in the amount of existing whitespace, like diff -b. Set no for exact comparison.

arguments.name: output_format
arguments.description: Diff output format: normal shows changed lines only; unified shows three lines of unchanged context. Default normal.

commands.help: Show source diffs for all decks whose contents differ between the selected versions. Include inherited decks and represent added or removed source with /dev/null. Added or removed empty decks have an explicit notice. By default ignore whitespace amount changes and trailing whitespace, like diff -b. Set ignore_space_changes=no for exact comparison. Default to normal diff output; use output_format=unified for unified output with three context lines. Unified textual output uses quoted a/ and b/ recorded filenames and tab-separated versions, suitable for patch -p1. Search limits fall back to complete replacements rather than minimal hunks. For an exact textual patch suitable for patch -p1, set output_format=unified ignore_space_changes=no. The default ignore_space_changes=yes is for review and can omit whitespace-only changes; it does not guarantee reconstruction of the target bytes.

commands.name: display_version_history
commands.summary: Show versions, lock status, lock times, and descriptions.

arguments.name: display_description
arguments.description: Show only the first description line (short), or the complete description (full).

arguments.name: limit
arguments.description: Number of most recent versions to show, including the current version. Default 10; use 0 for all versions.

commands.help: Display the most recent library versions in chronological order, including the current version. The default limit is 10; use limit=0 for every version. Show each version with its lock status, UTC lock timestamp, and description. Older versions without a recorded timestamp show None. By default show only the first line of each description. Use display_description=full to include the complete description; embedded line breaks are escaped so each version stays on one output line. Positional arguments are display_description followed by limit; named arguments and aliases may be mixed with positional values. Wrap descriptions first, preserving full UTC timestamps when space permits; use labelled fields on very narrow terminals.

commands.name: edit_file_patterns
commands.summary: Edit the library file patterns, one wildcard or filename per line.
commands.help: Open the file_patterns list in the configured editor. Enter one wildcard or exact filename per line, for files directly in the library directory; blank lines are ignored and surrounding whitespace is trimmed. Preserve spaces within filenames. Save and close the editor to store the list automatically. An empty list clears the selection. Directory components, including subdirectory patterns, are rejected; subdirectory support is planned as a future library option. Configure GUI editors with a wait option, such as editor=["code", "--wait"]. The list is library-wide and can be edited while the current version is locked. Run import_deck without arguments to snapshot the configured files; this editor command itself does not import files. Invalid edits are preserved in a private recovery file, whose path is included in the error.

examples.description: Edit entries such as *.pas, *.inc, and Makefile, one per line.

commands.name: extract_deck
commands.summary: Write the original source bytes to a file.

arguments.name: deck_name
arguments.description: Name of the deck to extract.

arguments.name: output_file
arguments.description: Destination for original bytes. Defaults to the selected revision's recorded source filename, or the deck name if absent; an explicit output_file is honored.

arguments.name: revision
arguments.description: Deck revision within the selected library version, from 0.000 to 0.999. Omit to select the latest visible deck revision, including inherited decks.

arguments.name: version
arguments.description: Library version containing the deck; defaults to scu$current_version. Combine with revision=0.001, or supply a complete deck version such as 1.1-0.001.

arguments.name: replace
arguments.description: Explicitly replace edited or untracked output files. Edited source files require explicit replacement; SQLite libraries remain protected.

arguments.name: build
arguments.description: Run the configured build command after extraction, from the library directory.

commands.help: Select a library version (default scu$current_version) and optionally a deck revision within that version. With no revision, select the latest visible deck, including inherited decks. Version and revision may be combined, for example version=1.1 revision=0.001. A complete deck version such as version=1.1-0.001 is equivalent; do not combine it with a separate revision. Write the original source bytes, including COPY directives and macro text. Internal library revision numbers are not command selectors. Default to the recorded source filename beside the library; honor an explicit output_file unchanged. Differing untracked or locally edited outputs require replace=yes; SQLite libraries cannot be overwritten. Run the configured build command from the library directory after successful extraction; build=no skips it. Preserve the recorded filename's case; fall back to the deck name only when no source filename was recorded. Restoring old source files does not change the current library version; import records them as new revisions.

Preserve macro text without expansion. Update the export manifest, then run the configured build once from the library directory unless build=no. Unchanged files need no replacement permission; edited or untracked differing files require replace=yes. SQLite libraries cannot be overwritten. Preserve the recorded filename's case; fall back to the deck name only when no source filename was recorded. commands.name: import_deck
commands.summary: Snapshot selected files or import one deck, creating, updating, or deleting revisions.

arguments.name: deck_name
arguments.description: Deck to create, revise, or recreate. Omit to snapshot file_patterns in the library directory.

arguments.name: source_file
arguments.description: Bare source filename in the library directory. Directory components and absolute paths are errors. Defaults to the deck's recorded filename. Requires deck_name.

arguments.name: comment-prefix
arguments.description: Comment prefix for new or changed revisions. Omit to retain each deck prefix or use the version default for new decks.

commands.help: With deck_name, import a source file into a new, existing, or deleted deck. source_file must be a bare filename in the library directory; directory components and absolute paths are rejected. Omit it to use the deck's recorded filename. Without deck_name or source_file, scan file_patterns relative to the library directory: store new files, revise changed files, and create deletion revisions for missing decks covered by those patterns. Compare exact source bytes; unchanged decks keep their deck versions, including inherited decks. Show changed decks, resolved deck versions, and new/changed/deleted status in aligned columns, followed by counts. Commit the whole snapshot and its audit records together. A failed scan leaves the library unchanged. Scan only the directory containing the library, without descending into subdirectories. Directory components in file_patterns are rejected; subdirectory support is planned as a future library option. Unsupported deck filenames and case-normalized name collisions are errors. Ignore directories, operational SQLite files, and the export manifest; reject selected symlinks. Wildcards use *, ?, and bracket expressions in filenames. Narrowing file_patterns does not delete decks outside the new selection. Requires an unlocked version. Non-deck filenames (spaces, Unicode or long names) receive stable hashed deck IDs in scans while preserving their exact filename. Working-manifest updates commit through a replayable SQLite observation queue; no source file is rewritten.

arguments.name: version
arguments.description: Library version to publish completely, including inherited decks. Default scu$current_version.

arguments.name: output_directory

arguments.name: replace
arguments.description: Explicitly replace edited outputs or remove untracked matching release files. SQLite storage and working sources remain protected.

commands.help: Write every live deck in the selected version, including inherited decks, to release_directory (default release beside the library). Every run publishes the full snapshot. Expand only uppercase SCU$DATE, SCU$TIME, SCU$DATE_TIME, SCU$DECK_VERSION, and SCU$VERSION. Date/time values are the deck modification timestamp in UTC; VERSION is the selected library version. COPY directives and other text remain literal. Remove obsolete regular files previously recorded by this library matching file_patterns only when absent from the selected snapshot; untracked matching files are named and kept unless replace=yes; keep unrelated files, subdirectories, symbolic links, and SQLite storage. Update the export manifest with recoverable writes and deletions. Edited tracked outputs require replace=yes. No build command runs during publication. Use each selected revision's recorded source filename, preserving case and exact bytes. Warn once if former COPY directives are found; they remain literal.

commands.name: verify_decks
commands.summary: Verify tracked exports against the latest visible deck versions.

arguments.name: output_directory
arguments.description: Directory to verify. Default release_directory; use scu$library_directory for extracted source files.

arguments.name: version
arguments.description: Library version whose latest visible decks to verify. Defaults to scu$current_version.

commands.help: Verify files recorded in .scu-exports.json without overwriting them or running builds. Automatically reconcile interrupted manifest updates; report interrupted exports requiring explicit re-export when the file matches neither the previous nor intended checksum. Compare extraction with original source and expansion with expanded release macros. Release macro values come from stored deck modification times and the selected version, so verification is deterministic. Report current, outdated, locally modified, missing, unavailable, or untracked files. Return a failing exit status when any tracked file needs attention. Existing untracked files whose names match known decks are reported as untracked; renamed old exports cannot be identified automatically. Records for other libraries are ignored. Use compact File, Mode, Exported, Latest, and Status columns with detailed errors and custom deck mappings below the table. Both version columns are deck versions. delete_deck does not immediately change exports. A release publication removes obsolete matching files and their manifest records; retained deleted exports are reported as deleted. Finish with a Needs attention list naming every affected deck, file, and full reason; omit current files and continue after individual file read errors. Successful verification ends with No errors were found. Retry pending committed working-file observations when verifying the library directory. Warn once for former COPY directives without expanding them.
